title: wasm exports rw_engine_follow / rw_engine_free_run for the AudioWorklet
description:
## Intent
Let the AudioWorklet pass clock lines to the wasm mixer (consumed in M3).

## Steps
1. `crates/apricity-web/src/lib.rs`: `rw_engine_follow(beat_at, frame_at, tempo, playing, quantum)` and `rw_engine_free_run()`, plus `rw_engine_clock_tempo()` for status; the same bounds and panic rules as the rest of the FFI (see apricitus-205813).
2. `web/src/wasm/shim.d.ts` typings.
3. `web/test/wasm.test.mjs`: a case that follows a scripted clock through the wasm mixer and checks bar 1 lands on the clock's bar line.

## Verify
`cargo build -p apricity-web --release --target wasm32-wasip1 && node web/test/wasm.test.mjs`.

Commit: `feat(<this task id>): wasm clock-following exports`.

## Protocol
Specs first, watched red; log decisions, problems and outcomes with `kbs comment`; run Verify and paste the tail. Every Bash call starts `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && cd /Users/home/Projects/Apricity`; cargo with `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 RUST_TEST_THREADS=2` under `safe-run.sh --`. Never change dependencies to make a build pass. Sub-agents never commit, push or close.
